verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is a physical consumer GPU that the buyer owns and installs in their own PC. 'Self-hosting the core product' is a software/SaaS deployment axis and is a category error for discrete hardware. The evidence about running AI models locally concerns hosting third-party models on the GPU, not self-hosting the product itself, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
